			<!-- 
  COLLE CE CODE dans WPCode → Nouveau Snippet → HTML/JS
  Ou dans Elementor → HTML widget sur chaque page
  
  Ce script gère l'affichage/masquage des formulaires au clic des boutons.
  Les boutons Elementor doivent avoir comme lien : #ms-resa-surf (ou autre ID)
-->
<script>
(function(){
  function showForm(id){
    var el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!el)return;
    el.style.display='block';
    setTimeout(function(){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});},80);
  }
  function hideForm(id){
    var el=document.getElementById(id);
    if(el)el.style.display='none';
  }
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    // Clic sur lien ancre #ms-resa-xxx
    var a=e.target.closest('a[href^="#ms-resa-"]');
    if(a){
      e.preventDefault();
      showForm(a.getAttribute('href').substring(1));
      return;
    }
    // Clic sur bouton fermer
    var cls=e.target.closest('.msw-close-btn');
    if(cls){
      e.preventDefault();
      hideForm(cls.getAttribute('data-close'));
      return;
    }
  });
})();
</script><style class="wpcode-css-snippet">.pum-overlay {

					<p class="e-6275bfe-a1cf5ac e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="6275bfe">One big family</p>
					<p class="e-5f4b622-d2e8d81 e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="5f4b622">At MOGASURF Camp, every day is about more than surfing or kitesurfing. It's about meeting people from around the world, sharing homemade meals, exploring Essaouira and creating unforgettable memories together. From daily sessions on the water to relaxed evenings at the villa, every moment is designed to help you progress, disconnect from everyday life and enjoy an experience you'll remember long after your stay.<br><br><br>Whether you're travelling solo, with friends, as a couple or with your family, you'll find a warm, international atmosphere where everyone feels welcome, progresses at their own pace and leaves with new friendships and unforgettable memories.</p>

<script>
(function(){
  var slider=document.getElementById('inclSlider');
  var dotsEl=document.getElementById('inclDots');
  if(!slider)return;
  var cards=slider.querySelectorAll('[data-card]');
  var dots=dotsEl?dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.incl-dot'):[];
  var down=false,startX=0,scrollStart=0,moved=false;
  slider.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    down=true;moved=false;startX=e.clientX;scrollStart=slider.scrollLeft;
    slider.classList.add('dragging');
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){
    if(!down)return;
    var dx=e.clientX-startX;
    if(Math.abs(dx)>3)moved=true;
    slider.scrollLeft=scrollStart-dx;
  });
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',function(){
    down=false;slider.classList.remove('dragging');
  });
  slider.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){
    if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY))return;
    var atStart=slider.scrollLeft<=0;
    var atEnd=slider.scrollLeft>=slider.scrollWidth-slider.clientWidth-1;
    if((atStart&&e.deltaY<0)||(atEnd&&e.deltaY>0))return;
    e.preventDefault();slider.scrollLeft+=e.deltaY;
  },{passive:false});
  cards.forEach(function(card){
    card.addEventListener('click',function(e){
      if(moved){e.preventDefault();return;}
      cards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('is-selected');});
      card.classList.add('is-selected');
    });
  });
  function updateDots(){
    if(!cards.length||!dots.length)return;
    var cw=cards[0].offsetWidth+20;
    var idx=Math.min(Math.round(slider.scrollLeft/cw),dots.length-1);
    dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('on',i===idx);});
  }
  slider.addEventListener('scroll',updateDots,{passive:true});
  dots.forEach(function(d,i){
    d.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var cw=cards[0]?cards[0].offsetWidth+20:320;
      slider.scrollTo({left:i*cw,behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
})();
</script>				</div>
					</div>
				</div>

function fmtd(iso){var p=iso.split('-');return p[2]+'/'+p[1]+'/'+p[0]}

function visibleDates(m){
  return m.dates.filter(function(d){return s.act==='yoga'?!!d.yoga:!d.yoga});
}
function buildMonths(){
  var sel=g('bk-month'),html='';
  if(s.act==='yoga'){
    html='<option value="2027-03">'+T.yoga_month_lbl+'</option>';
  }else{
    DATA.forEach(function(m){if(visibleDates(m).length)html+='<option value="'+m.k+'">'+m.label+'</option>'});
    html+='<option value="custom">'+"✏️ Choose my own dates"+'</option>';
  }
  sel.innerHTML=html;
  var valid=false;for(var i=0;i<sel.options.length;i++)if(sel.options[i].value===s.month)valid=true;
  if(!valid)s.month=sel.options[0].value;
  sel.value=s.month;

function buildDates(){
  var box=g('bk-dates'),wrap=g('bk-dates-wrap'),cb=g('bk-custom-block');
  box.innerHTML='';
  if(s.month==='custom'){wrap.classList.remove('show');cb.classList.add('show');return}

function startIso(){
  if(s.date==='custom')return g('bk-date-from').value||null;
  return s.date||null;
}
function upd(){
  var st=startIso();
  if(!s.act||s.act==='yoga'||!s.date||!st){g('bk-price').classList.add('hidden');return}
  var r=rateFor(st),p=(r==='reg')?REG[s.act]:SPECIAL[s.act];
  g('bk-price').classList.remove('hidden');
  g('bk-pamt').textContent=money(p*s.n);
  var who=s.n+' '+(s.n>1?T.peopleN:T.people1);
  var sub=money(p)+' × '+who+' · ';
  if(r==='reg'){sub+=T.lbl_regular}
  else{sub+=(r==='lm'?T.lbl_last_minute:T.lbl_special)+' ('+T.instead+' <s>'+money(REF[s.act])+'</s>)'}

  g('bk-psub').innerHTML=sub;
}

  m.dates.forEach(function(x){if(x.s===s.date)d=x});
  return {a:d.s,b:d.e};
}

<script>
(function(){
  var track=document.getElementById('progTrack');
  var dotsEl=document.getElementById('progDots');
  var prevBtn=document.getElementById('prog-prev');
  var nextBtn=document.getElementById('prog-next');
  if(!track)return;
  var cards=track.querySelectorAll('[data-card]');
  var dots=dotsEl?dotsEl.querySelectorAll('.prog-dot'):[];
  var current=0;
  var down=false,startX=0,scrollStart=0,moved=false;
  track.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){down=true;moved=false;startX=e.clientX;scrollStart=track.scrollLeft;track.classList.add('dragging');});
  window.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!down)return;var dx=e.clientX-startX;if(Math.abs(dx)>3)moved=true;track.scrollLeft=scrollStart-dx;});
  window.addEventListener('pointerup',function(){down=false;track.classList.remove('dragging')});
  track.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){if(Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY))return;var atStart=track.scrollLeft<=0;var atEnd=track.scrollLeft>=track.scrollWidth-track.clientWidth-1;if((atStart&&e.deltaY<0)||(atEnd&&e.deltaY>0))return;e.preventDefault();track.scrollLeft+=e.deltaY;},{passive:false});
  cards.forEach(function(card){card.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(moved){e.preventDefault();return;}cards.forEach(function(c){c.classList.remove('is-selected')});card.classList.add('is-selected');});});
  function getCardW(){return cards[0]?cards[0].offsetWidth+20:320}
  function goTo(idx){current=Math.max(0,Math.min(cards.length-1,idx));track.scrollTo({left:current*getCardW(),behavior:'smooth'});dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('on',i===current)});}
  track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){var idx=Math.round(track.scrollLeft/getCardW());if(idx!==current){current=idx;dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.classList.toggle('on',i===current)})}},{passive:true});
  dots.forEach(function(d,i){d.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(i)})});
  if(prevBtn)prevBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(current-1)});
  if(nextBtn)nextBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){goTo(current+1)});
})();
</script>				</div>

var ALT="surf camp Essaouira",PREV="Previous photo",NEXT="Next photo";
var cur=null,idx=0,tok=0,lastTile=null;
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')}

function preload(r,i){
  [i,(i+1)%r.imgs.length,(i-1+r.imgs.length)%r.imgs.length].forEach(function(n){var im=new Image();im.src=r.imgs[n];});
}
function show(i,animate){
  var r=ROOMS[cur];idx=i;
  var img=$('roomGalleryImg'),t=++tok;
  function apply(){if(t!==tok)return;img.src=r.imgs[i];img.alt=r.name+', '+r.villa+', '+ALT+' ('+(i+1)+'/'+r.imgs.length+')';img.classList.remove('fading');}
  if(animate){img.classList.add('fading');setTimeout(apply,200);}else{apply();}
  $('roomGalleryCounter').textContent=(i+1)+' / '+r.imgs.length;
  var dots=document.querySelectorAll('.rooms-gallery-dot');
  for(var d=0;d<dots.length;d++)dots[d].classList.toggle('on',d===i);
  preload(r,i);
}
function open(key,tile){
  var tiles=document.querySelectorAll('.room-tile');
  for(var t=0;t<tiles.length;t++)tiles[t].classList.remove('is-selected');
  tile.classList.add('is-selected');lastTile=tile;
  var r=ROOMS[key];cur=key;
  $('roomVilla').textContent='📍 '+r.villa;
  $('roomBadge').textContent=r.badge;
  $('roomName').textContent=r.name;
  $('roomDesc').textContent=r.desc;
  $('roomFeats').innerHTML=r.feats.map(function(f){return '<li class="rooms-feat"><span class="rooms-feat-ico" aria-hidden="true">'+f.ico+'</span>'+esc(f.txt)+'</li>'}).join('');
  $('roomGalleryDots').innerHTML=r.imgs.map(function(_,i){return '<button class="rooms-gallery-dot'+(i===0?' on':'')+'" data-i="'+i+'" aria-label="Photo '+(i+1)+'"></button>'}).join('');
  show(0,false);
  $('roomsModal').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  $('roomsClose').focus();
}
function close(){
  $('roomsModal').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
  var tiles=document.querySelectorAll('.room-tile');
  for(var t=0;t<tiles.length;t++)tiles[t].classList.remove('is-selected');
  if(lastTile)lastTile.focus();
}
function nav(d){var r=ROOMS[cur];show((idx+d+r.imgs.length)%r.imgs.length,true)}

var tiles=document.querySelectorAll('.room-tile');
for(var i=0;i<tiles.length;i++){
  (function(t){
    t.addEventListener('click',function(){open(t.getAttribute('data-room'),t)});
    t.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();open(t.getAttribute('data-room'),t)}});
  })(tiles[i]);
}
$('roomsClose').addEventListener('click',close);
$('roomPrev').addEventListener('click',function(){nav(-1)});
$('roomNext').addEventListener('click',function(){nav(1)});
$('roomsModal').addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this)close()});
$('roomGalleryDots').addEventListener('click',function(e){var b=e.target.closest('.rooms-gallery-dot');if(b)show(parseInt(b.getAttribute('data-i'),10),true)});

var track=$('roomsTrack'),pl=$('roomsPrevList'),nl=$('roomsNextList');
function step(){var t=track.querySelector('.room-tile');return t?t.getBoundingClientRect().width+16:300}
function upd(){
  var max=track.scrollWidth-track.clientWidth-2;
  pl.disabled=track.scrollLeft<=2;
  nl.disabled=track.scrollLeft>=max;
}
pl.addEventListener('click',function(){track.scrollBy({left:-step(),behavior:'smooth'})});
nl.addEventListener('click',function(){track.scrollBy({left:step(),behavior:'smooth'})});
track.addEventListener('scroll',function(){window.requestAnimationFrame(upd)},{passive:true});
window.addEventListener('resize',upd);
window.addEventListener('load',upd);
upd();

var sx=null;
var gal=$('roomsGallery');
gal.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){sx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX},{passive:true});
gal.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){if(sx===null)return;var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-sx;sx=null;if(Math.abs(dx)>40)nav(dx<0?1:-1)},{passive:true});

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(!$('roomsModal').classList.contains('open'))return;
  if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')nav(-1);
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight')nav(1);
  if(e.key==='Escape')close();
});
})();

<section class="faq" aria-label="Frequently asked questions — Mogasurf Camp">
  <span class="faq-eyebrow">Mogasurf · Surf & Kitesurf Camp</span>
  <h2 class="faq-title">Your questions, <em>our answers</em></h2>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>How do I book my stay?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      Booking is simple and quick. Fill in our booking form with your details and preferred dates. Our team will contact you within <strong>24 hours</strong> to confirm availability and finalize your booking.<br><br>
      To secure your spot at the camp, we require a <strong>20% deposit</strong> at the time of booking. The balance is paid on arrival, in cash.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>What level do I need to join the camp?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      The camp is open to <strong>all levels</strong>, from complete beginners to more experienced surfers or kiters. From your very first session, we form groups of <strong>maximum 4 people per instructor</strong>, based on your level and experience.<br><br>
      Groups are not fixed: they evolve throughout the stay so everyone can progress at their own pace and ride with people of a similar level.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>Is surf or kitesurf equipment provided?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      Yes, all the equipment you need is provided on-site:
      <ul>
        <li>Board suited to your level (surf or kitesurf)</li>
        <li>Wetsuit</li>
        <li>Leash (for surf)</li>
        <li>Kite, harness and helmet (for kitesurf)</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="faq-note">☀️ You don't need to bring anything, just your SPF and good vibes.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>Can I cancel or change my booking?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      Yes. For any cancellation or change, the conditions depend on when we receive your request. We recommend contacting us as early as possible so we can find the best solution: <strong>date change</strong>, postponement or cancellation according to the applicable conditions.<br><br>
      The exact terms are shared with you at the time of booking, everything is clear before any payment is made.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>How does the airport transfer work?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      The <strong>transfer from Essaouira airport is included</strong> in your stay. On arrival, our team will pick you up directly at the airport and drive you to Villa Sunset, a journey of around 10 minutes.<br><br>
      We also organize <strong>daily transfers</strong> between the villa and the surf & kitesurf spots, so you don't have to worry about logistics.
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="faq-item" data-faq>
    <div class="faq-q" onclick="faqToggle(this)" role="button" tabindex="0">
      <span>What happens if the weather conditions are bad?</span>
      <span class="faq-icon">+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="faq-a">
      Safety and the quality of the experience always come first. Sessions are always adapted to ocean conditions and the group's level.<br><br>
      <strong>For surf:</strong> if conditions don't allow a session, the hours are made up during the stay so that all planned hours are completed before your departure.<br><br>
      <strong>For kitesurf:</strong> on low-wind days, we either replace the session with another activity or recover the hours on the following days.
      <div class="faq-note">🌊 Our goal: every one of your coaching hours is used before the end of your stay.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
function faqToggle(btn){
  var item=btn.closest('[data-faq]');
  var isOpen=item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-faq]').forEach(function(i){i.classList.remove('open')});
  if(!isOpen)item.classList.add('open');
}
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(function(btn){
  btn.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')faqToggle(btn)});
});
</script>				</div>

				</div>

            function runPixelCode( response ) {
                if ( ! response || ! response.data || ! response.data.fb_pxl_code ) {
                    return;
                }

                try {
                    new Function( response.data.fb_pxl_code )();
                } catch ( e ) {
                    console && console.warn
                        && console.warn( 'Meta Pixel response parsing failed. Please check if your pixel is connected.', e );
                }
            }

            var radio = window.nfRadio
                || ( window.Backbone && window.Backbone.Radio );
            if ( radio && radio.channel ) {
                radio.channel( 'forms' ).on( 'submit:response', runPixelCode );
            }

            if ( window.jQuery ) {
                window.jQuery( document ).on(
                    'nfFormSubmitResponse',
                    function ( event, data ) {
                        if ( data && data.response ) {
                            runPixelCode( data.response );
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        })();
        </script>

				( () => {
					const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
						const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
						const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
							entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
								if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
									let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
									if( lazyloadBackground ) {
										lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
									}
									lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
								}
							});
						}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
						lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
							lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
						} );
					};
					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',
					];
					events.forEach( ( event ) => {

  fd.append("Email",em);
  fd.append("botcheck","");
  fetch("https://api.web3forms.com/submit",{method:"POST",body:fd})
  .then(function(r){return r.json();})
  .then(function(){
    document.getElementById("moga-nl-form").style.display="none";
    document.getElementById("moga-nl-ok").style.display="block";
  });
}
</script>
